---
title: "Reading Log"
---

A chronological record of my reading activity, searchable by book and date.

```{r}
#| include: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(DT)

# Load our reusable functions
source("R/reading_helpers.R")

# Import datasets
books <- read_csv(
  "data/books.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

reading_log <- read_csv(
  "data/reading_log.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    book_id = col_character(),
    date = col_date(),
    page_reached = col_integer()
  )
)

# Calculate reading progress for all books
book_progress <- calculate_book_progress(
  books,
  reading_log
)

# Identify dates without recorded reading
empty_days <- tibble(
  date = seq.Date(
    min(book_progress$date),
    max(book_progress$date),
    by = "day"
  )
) |>
  anti_join(
    book_progress |> distinct(date),
    by = "date"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    title = "No reading logged",
    page_reached = NA_integer_,
    pages_read = 0L
  )

# Combine recorded reading and empty days
display_log <- book_progress |>
  select(date, title, pages_read, page_reached) |>
  bind_rows(empty_days) |>
  arrange(desc(date), title)
```

## Reading History

The table below records my daily reading activity across all books. Days without recorded reading are included, and the entries can be searched and sorted.

```{r}
#| echo: false

display_log |>
  datatable(
    rownames = FALSE,
    colnames = c(
      "Date",
      "Book",
      "Pages Read",
      "Page Reached"
    ),
    options = list(
      pageLength = 15,
      searching = TRUE,
      ordering = TRUE,
      order = list(list(0, "desc"))
    )
  )
```
